notes.title: 🎥 Behind the Scenes of Blippo+ - A Tease of the game's making of documentary
notes.content: [h2]Ambitious to the point of danger: what did it take to create Blippo+? COMING SOON: a behind-the-scenes look at building Planet Blip![/h2][p][/p][h2]Check out this teaser for the upcoming making-of documentary and get to meet some of the people who made it happen.[/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="Yf15ePYWvzE;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]Blippo+ arrives on Home Computers September 23rd! 💻 [/h2]
